items.story: കോൺഗ്രസ് നേതാവ് പ്രിയങ്ക ഗാന്ധിയുടെ മകൻ റെയ്‌ഹാൻ വാദ്രയുടെ ചിത്രപ്രദർശനത്തിന് ഡൽഹിയിൽ വിലക്ക് ഏർപ്പെടുത്തി. തെരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പ് കമ്മീഷണറുടെ രാജി ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടുള്ള പ്രക്ഷോഭങ്ങളുടെയും ദേശീയ പതാകയുടെയും ചിത്രങ്ങൾ ഒഴിവാക്കാൻ അധികൃതർ ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടു. എന്നാൽ ഈ നിർദ്ദേശം നിരസിച്ച റെയ്‌ഹാൻ, മുഴുവൻ ചിത്രങ്ങളുടെയും പ്രദർശനം മറ്റൊരു വേദിയിൽ നടത്തുമെന്ന് അറിയിച്ചു.

items.teaser: Over the past 30 years, Swiss barn owls have become more reddish-brown and more heavily spotted. By analyzing the genomes of more than 3,…
items.story: Over the past 30 years, Swiss barn owls have become more reddish-brown and more heavily spotted. By analyzing the genomes of more than 3,000 birds, scientists at the University of Lausanne identified the genetic variants linked to these changes in plumage and revealed natural selection at work. Their findings, published in Nature Communications, show that evolution can happen rapidly in the wild.

items.headline: X-ray free-electron laser sets new record for shortest high-energy pulses
items.teaser: Researchers at the Linac Coherent Light Source (LCLS) at the U.S. Department of Energy's SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory have measur…
items.story: Researchers at the Linac Coherent Light Source (LCLS) at the U.S. Department of Energy's SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory have measured the shortest high-energy X-ray pulses ever recorded at an X-ray free-electron laser (XFEL). The pulses had photon energies of about 9 kiloelectronvolts (keV) and clocked in at durations of 100 to 400 attoseconds—mere billionths of a billionth of a second. The results are published in Nature Photonics.

items.story: Bacteria and the viruses that infect them—known as phages—coexist in soils, oceans and living organisms. Scientists have long thought this coexistence reflects a microscopic version of an evolutionary arms race: As parasites and hosts continually adapt to one another, both evolve ways to survive. But a joint study by researchers at the University of Maryland and the University of Exeter shows different pathways to coexistence.

items.story: Local Body Elections: ఏపీలో పట్టణ స్థానిక సంస్థల ఎన్నికల ప్రక్రియకు తాత్కాలికంగా బ్రేక్‌: ఎస్‌ఈసీ Eenaduనామినేషన్ల గడువు పొడిగింపుపై పిటిషన్‌.. సుప్రీంకోర్టు కీలక ఆదేశాలు Eenaduఏపీలో మున్సిపల్ ఎన్నికల ప్రక్రియకు బ్రేక్.. ఎస్‌ఈసీ కీలక ఆదేశాలు Sakshiసుప్రీం ఆదేశాలు మాకు బూస్ట్ ఇచ్చాయి: పెద్దిరెడ్డి రామచంద్రారెడ్డి AP7AMసుప్రీం కోర్టు ఆదేశాల పై సిపిఐ(యం) హర్షం Prajasakti
